title: Wood River Exhibit B-1 RRFF Labor Burden Buildup
sourceTitle: Wood River Exhibit B-1 RRFF Labor Burden Buildup
note: Wood River RRFF Exhibit B-1 craft sheets — Pay Tax FICA-MC / FUI / SUI, Ins, Misc, O/H, Profit, and Fringes Subtotal as $/hr hall by hall. Burden Summary pivot in the official book is an empty shell; craft-sheet columns are the source. Not a placeholder Illinois composite. Separate labor-burden book from T&M / Union_TM — never mix wages or burden. Does not write live Rate Tables.
